name: FinanceOS – Vendor Invoice 3-Way Match (PO · GRN · Invoice) with GST/TDS Checks, Slack Approvals & Weekly Payment Batch

parameters.content:
## 🧾 FinanceOS – Vendor Invoice 3-Way Match

For finance teams at Indian companies who still match vendor invoices against POs and GRNs by hand in Excel. Duplicate bills slip through, wrong GST splits get paid, and TDS is calculated at the wrong rate.

### How it works
Invoices arriving in a labelled Gmail inbox are archived to Drive and read by GPT-4o. Each line is matched to its purchase order and the goods actually received. The workflow checks price and quantity, GSTIN validity, CGST/SGST vs IGST, TDS section and duplicates, then posts the invoice to the AP ledger with a decision: auto-approve, send for approval, or hold.

Approvers approve or reject from Slack with one click. Held invoices get an AI-drafted query to the vendor for review. Every Friday, approved invoices due in the coming week are grouped into a bank-ready payment CSV.

### Setup steps
1. In Gmail, create an `invoices` label and filter vendor emails into it.
2. Create a Google Sheet with **Vendor Master**, **Purchase Orders**, **GRNs**, **AP Ledger** and **Vendor Bank Details** tabs, plus two Drive folders.
3. Connect Gmail, Google Sheets, Drive, Slack and OpenAI.
4. In **3-Way Match & GST/TDS Checks**, set your GSTIN, auto-approve limit, tolerances, approver levels and n8n domain.
5. Forward a sample invoice to test, then activate.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Invoice Intake & AI Extraction

parameters.content:
## 📥 Invoice Intake & AI Extraction
Picks up PDF or image invoices from Gmail messages labelled `invoices`, archives each one to Drive, and has GPT-4o read the vendor, GSTIN, PO number, line items and tax split.

## 🔍 3-Way Match & GST/TDS Checks
Each line is matched to its PO and received GRN quantity, with price tolerance and over-billing checks. GSTINs are checksum-validated, the CGST/SGST or IGST split is checked, TDS is set by section, and duplicates are caught before posting.

## 🚦 Route Outcomes
Clean invoices under the auto-approve limit just get a Slack FYI. Others go to the right approver in Slack with Approve and Reject links. Invoices on hold get an AI-drafted query to the vendor, saved as a Gmail draft, and a Slack note.

## ✅ Approval Links
The Slack buttons open this webhook. A one-time token is checked against the ledger before the decision is saved, so old or forwarded links can't change anything. The approver sees a confirmation page and Slack is updated.

## 📅 Weekly Payment Batch
Every Friday at 11 AM IST, approved invoices due in the next seven days are grouped by vendor, with TDS already netted off.

## 🏦 Bank File & Schedule
The batch becomes a bank-upload CSV (NEFT, or RTGS from ₹2 lakh) saved to Drive. The invoices are marked as scheduled and finance gets a Slack summary. Vendors with missing bank details are flagged in the file.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Vendor bank details and the payment CSV are sensitive, so restrict access to that sheet and Drive folder. Use OAuth2 for Google and Slack. Approval links are one-time, but keep the Slack channel limited to approvers.
